description: A new class of hybrid AI systems, combining symbolic reasoning engines with narrow neural modules, demonstrates unexpectedly robust performance in high-assurance domains like air traffic coordination and medical triage under stress conditions. These systems, developed in EU-funded research hubs leveraging the emergent_ai_research_shift, show minimal drift over extended operation and are amenable to formal verification. The breakthrough does not match frontier capability but offers a credible alternative path for sovereign, auditable AI in critical infrastructure, attracting interest from national regulators.
